links.outcome: Temporal stability of AUROC for T2D prediction across years after training period
links.quote: The model showed good discriminative performance across all years (AUROC for 2018 = 0.84, 2019 = 0.83, 2020 = 0.87, 2021 = 0.80, 2022 = 0.84, 2023 = 0.80), with a linear model estimating a decrease in AUROC for T2D prediction of only 0.004 per year (95%CI: -0.024; 0.016).
